description:
Hello friends, in this video we are discussing on this video on the topic "how to update KYC in ICICI Bank online, ICICI Bank me KYC update kaise kare?". If you are an ICICI Bank customer and you have to complete e-KYC in your ICICI Bank account then how to do e-KYC on ICICI Bank account.

Many of ICICI Bank account holders search the following questions on YouTube:

how to update KYC in ICICI Bank online,
ICICI Bank me KYC update kaise kare,
ICICI bank kyc update online 2025,
How to update kyc in icici bank,
how to update kyc in icici bank app,
icici bank kyc update in imobile app,
update kyc in icici savings account online,
how to update kyc in imobile app,
icici bank ki kyc kaise kare,
icici bank e kyc kaise kare,
icici bank e kyc online etc.

You will find all the answers of the above questions in this video. If you are also searching for this topic then watch this video till end or follow the following steps.

1. Go to iMobile app and login to your account.
2. Click on "proceed to e-KYC" link on the pop up message if appeared, otherwise click on the 'services' option on the dashboard of account.
3. Click on "Update KYC/ profile" then click on 'Update KYC'.
4. Select customer Id and click on 'proceed to update KYC'.
5. Allow the location.
6. Account details will appear, click on 'Proceed to e-KYC'.
7. Enter your Aadhaar number, accept the terms and conditions click on 'generate OTP'.
8. Enter OTP and click on 'verify OTP'.
9. Data of Aadhaar and account will be compared. Scroll down the page select you want to change address or not and then accept the terms and condition and click on 'Proceed to FATCA Details'.
10. Enter current residential status details and trick on the box before the declaration then click on 'Proceed to Profile details'.
11. Enter the profile details, trick on the box before 'I have read and understood' and click on 'Confirm details'.
12. Entered details will be displayed on the screen. Click on 'Proceed for e-Sign'.
11. Redirected to e-Sign website. click on the box before the terms and conditions and click on 'Proceed'.
12. E-sign document will appear, click on 'Proceed'.
13. Trick on the box before the consent click on 'accept & eSign'.
14. enter Aadhaar number trick on the box before the declaration and click on 'Perform eSign'.
15. Confirm the details appeared on the screen, click on 'submit'.
16. A message will be appeared 'Congratulations! You have submitted your details successfully'.
